title: University of Cambridge whistleblower who reported alleged bullying wins employment tribunal

paragraphs.en: A University of Cambridge whistleblower who alleged bullying of female staff inside the university’s Institute of Astronomy has won a tribunal against his employer.
paragraphs.zh: 一位举报剑桥大学天文研究所（Institute of Astronomy）女性员工遭受欺凌的剑桥大学举报人，在就业法庭诉讼中胜诉。

paragraphs.en: Prof Wyn Evans told a tribunal hearing in June that the institute suffered from “a bad history of misogyny”. He claimed that one woman in the department had been “hounded out of a job”, another was “left a frightened woman”, and a third had faced “aggressive professors” at the institute.
paragraphs.zh: 温·埃文斯（Wyn Evans）教授在 6 月的法庭听证会上表示，该研究所“存在厌女的不良历史”。他声称，系里一名女性曾被“逼得丢掉了工作”，另一名女性“被吓得战战兢兢”，还有一名女性在该研究所遭遇过“咄咄逼人的教授”。

paragraphs.en: The tribunal found that after raising concerns, Evans was “subjected to a prolonged nearly two-year investigation by the university”, even though the allegations against him “contained scant particularisation, and no evidence to support them”.
paragraphs.zh: 法庭认定，在提出担忧之后，埃文斯“遭受了该大学长达近两年的调查”，尽管针对他的指控“几乎没有任何具体细节，也没有任何证据支持”。

paragraphs.en: The tribunal said its job was not to “conduct a public inquiry into alleged bullying or misogyny within the Institute of Astronomy at the University of Cambridge” but concluded it was “satisfied that the claimant genuinely believed that there was a problem within the institute about the way female administrators were being treated”.
paragraphs.zh: 法庭表示，其职责不是“对剑桥大学天文研究所内部涉嫌的欺凌或厌女行为进行公开调查”，但得出结论称，法庭“确信申诉人真诚地相信，该研究所在女行政人员的待遇方面存在问题”。

paragraphs.en: It found that Cambridge “did not even want to consider” Evans’s complaints under its whistleblowing policy, and described “an institutional mindset” that viewed the professor of astrophysics as “a source of difficulty and continuing reputational risk due to his protected disclosures which might damage the institute and the university”.
paragraphs.zh: 法庭认定，剑桥大学“甚至不愿”依据其举报政策考虑埃文斯的投诉，并形容存在一种“机构心态”，将这位天体物理学教授视为“麻烦之源，因其受保护的披露可能损害研究所和大学，从而构成持续的名誉风险”。

paragraphs.en: The judgment comes at a torrid time for senior leaders at Cambridge, where academics are calling for an independent inquiry into the processes and circumstances that led to Jason Arday being appointed as the university’s youngest professor. Arday, who was appointed in 2023, stepped down earlier this month amid allegations of plagiarism and embellishing his CV.
paragraphs.zh: 这份判决公布之时，剑桥的高层领导人正处于艰难时期。学者们正在呼吁就杰森·阿德雷被任命为该校最年轻教授的过程和背景进行独立调查。阿德雷于 2023 年获聘，本月早些时候因抄袭和简历注水等指控而辞职。

paragraphs.en: After the tribunal in Bury St Edmunds, Employment Judge Graham found serious failures in the university’s handling of complaints by Evans, with 11 of 14 alleged detriments upheld against the university or individual respondents including the vice-chancellor.
paragraphs.zh: 在贝里圣埃德蒙兹（Bury St Edmunds）的法庭作出裁决后，就业法官格雷厄姆（Graham）认定，该大学在处理埃文斯的投诉方面存在严重失误，所提出的 14 项不利对待中，有 11 项对大学或包括副校长在内的各被告成立。

paragraphs.en: The investigation into Evans was found to be “contrary to natural justice”. The tribunal ruled it was “baseless (as nothing had been provided to support it) and it had been filed in retaliation … and was therefore likely malicious and vexatious”.
paragraphs.zh: 针对埃文斯的调查被认定“违背自然公正原则”。法庭裁定该调查“毫无根据（因为没有任何东西支持它），而且是出于报复而提出的……因此很可能带有恶意和骚扰性质”。
